suite: a window resize re-clamps the pane and the map (5120 to 1920, no reload)
expect_red: [real] shrinking the window to 1920 re-clamps the pane: the region equals a fresh load's (+-2px) and the map is drawn

mutations.contract: A window that shrinks with the 3D view open re-clamps the pane as a load does, so the map's region never drops to 0 wide.
mutations.note: The resize handler no longer refits the 3D view.
